main.description: Lists indexed activities. Filters combine with AND; values within each array filter combine with OR, and duplicate values are ignored. Authentication is not required.

hasOrganizationRecord.description: Filter by whether the activity author has an app.certified.actor.organization/self record, regardless of profile presence.

contributors.description: Filter by contributor DID, including inline identities and the exact referenced contributor-information version.

involvedActors.description: Filter by activity repository-owner or contributor DID.

uris.description: Filter by exact activity AT-URI; results follow the selected sort order, not input order.

sortDirection.description: Sort by activity createdAt, then URI; defaults to desc.

limit.description: Maximum activities per page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, bound to sortDirection. Keep all other query parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter, sort direction, page limit, cursor, or query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: ActivityQueryFailed
errors.description: The activity query or required hydration failed.

cursor.description: Next-page cursor; absent when pagination is complete.
